office_does: A Skagit County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, civil claims up to $100,000, small claims and protection orders; judges are elected countywide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Court Commissioner Patrick Eason is the only candidate for the seat of a retiring judge.

candidates.summary: Skagit County District Court commissioner since 2021 and former Mount Vernon assistant city attorney; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: District Court commissioner since July 2021, presiding over jury trials, sentencings and protection-order hearings [S1]
Former Mount Vernon assistant city attorney and deputy prosecutor in Skagit and Mason counties [S4]
Endorsed by more than 20 past and present Skagit County judges [S1]
